eintraege.text: Election results in states where voting ends early could indicate how each party will fare in House and Senate races elsewhere in the country.

eintraege.titel: More Iranians Call for Nuclear Weapons After War With U.S.
eintraege.text: Some Iranian clerics and officials argue the country must rebuild deterrence by dropping its longstanding pledge not to build a nuclear bomb.
